title: Herbal Flaky American Cornbread Fried-Rice
description: A unique twist on traditional cornbread, this herbal flaky American dish features sansho and is perfect for a crowd-pleasing lunch or dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together cornmeal, flour, baking powder, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together melted vegan butter, soy milk, chopped scallions, and diced red bell pepper.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Fold in chopped fresh cilantro and sliced sansho pepper.
Pour the batter into a greased 9x13-inch baking dish.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
While the cornbread is baking, heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add cooked rice to the skillet and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Once the cornbread is done, carefully remove it from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Use a spatula to carefully fold the cornbread into the fried rice.
Return the mixture to the skillet and continue to stir-fry for an additional 2-3 minutes.
